body: M9 is landed and pushed (e3f5f02): spec at research/M9_THE_SCALE_ON_THE_BELT.md, six boards at DesignLibrary/screens/belt_scale/m9_*, your HANDOFF block written. One land finding you should carry into the next pack: SELECT (#3A6FD8) is named in M4, M5, M7 and M9 token maps as a UITokens name, but it does not exist in Godot/scripts/UITokens.gd - the closest real constants are GYM_DEFAULT #2f6fb0 and LINK #7fb6ee. LINK and MUTED do match code. Please either keep citing SELECT as a board colour that the build must add, or map it to the GYM_DEFAULT ladder the way M4 did, but do not describe it as verified against UITokens.gd.
